# Paint Warhammer / Model-Painter — Extracted APK Vector Icons Library (46 Icons)

All vector icons extracted from the official `com.gamesworkshop.citadelpaint` v3.1.1 APK (`res/drawable/*.xml` converted to standard SVG). Use these exact SVG paths when generating or refining screens in Google Stitch.

## Brand Crests
- `ic_warhammercolour.svg` — Official Warhammer Colour crest (`#FBBA00` gold bar + `#000000` / `#FFFFFF` wordmark).
- `ic_warhammerpro.svg` — Official Warhammer Pro crest (`#57C2D0` -> `#9E5BD6` -> `#E3A73B` prismatic brush stroke).
